title: fix: source workspace workers load from external working directories
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Source workspace workers fail to load when their working directory is outside the checkout.

## User Impact

Source-run workspace and Skills operations work from external working directories. No required-worker policy or new core surface is introduced.

## Why This Change Was Made

Supply the source worker its existing checkout TypeScript configuration and remove three obsolete test workarounds. This is the independent first prerequisite extracted from [the original feature PR](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/158903), preserving its contributor history there.

## Prior-head evidence

- Two real file-transfer/Skills suites: **41 tests passed**, Vitest **78.04s**, full `pnpm test` command **223.78s** including prerequisite generation; source-worker lifecycle case **8.608s**.
- Fresh independent review: no actionable P0–P2 findings.
- Production and all core/root/extension test typechecks, formatting, ratchets, dependency/boundary checks and dead-export scans passed. The full changed-file gate completed successfully, including targeted lint. Exact-head [GitHub CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37633806429) passed on `38840d71b879905a33d4727a681c7d26dd67f907`, including the required `openclaw/ci-gate`.
- **+14/−57 lines across four files; +14/−1 production lines.**
- Ready for review, not authorized for merge. ClawSweeper reviewed the exact head: **Platinum Hermit**, no code or security findings. GitHub reports conflict-free/mergeable. CI run completed successfully: **4,525 summed job-seconds** across successful CI jobs (whole run, not marginal test cost); no new tests were added. This is the first prerequisite; later slices remain separate.

## Current validation status

Current head `61cdd14ba5a2bc1ddc1e35b8150bb4da64a7d458` integrates exact upstream continuation/sharing-authority fix `f6e6805b99b`, UI fixture fix `1d10375ee563`, and archive read-context teardown fix `4ed39a25f674`, in addition to earlier Doctor/update fixture fixes. These resolve reproduced inherited CI failures in the stack. All 4 introduced paths are byte-identical to the prior reviewed candidate; behavioral proof remains valid. Prior-head hosted CI/review is not current-head evidence. Exact-head [CI run 37662793263](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37662793263) succeeded, including all required status contexts. Fresh exact-head ClawSweeper: **Platinum Hermit, no actionable findings, ready**. Non-draft, GitHub **MERGEABLE/CLEAN**, zero unresolved review threads. Fully ready for review; no merges or automerge.
